text:
pagerbot: [PagerDuty] page fired for service="inference-frontend" — high 5xx rate detected in regions: us-west, eu-west. Incident INC1234567. Trigger: 5xx spike >20% sustained for 2m. @channel :rotating_light:

alex: acked on PagerDuty and taking initial triage. brief: customers seeing ~30% errors and tail latency jumps to 5-10s. linking logs now.

maya: I'm on standby and can take if alex needs to hand off. I can pull autoscaler metrics and check model pool.

sam: adding quick context — we just had a minor config rollout to the ingress proxy 6m ago; not sure if related. Noticed increased connection resets from embedder in eu-west.

oncall-rotation: current primary oncall is alex until 1732468600. If alex hands off, runbook suggests leaving a 1-line status update every 5m.

alex: quick checks —
`kubectl get hpa -n inference` shows no spike in replicas (weird).
`kubectl logs -n inference deploy/inference-frontend | grep ERROR | tail -n 50` gives lots of `upstream error: connection reset by peer` for embedder endpoints.

alex: I'm going to scale the pool manually to see if capacity helps. Scaling dedicated pool by +50% (manual) now. Will monitor.

infra-bot: autoscaler activity suppressed due to recent rollout flag `autoscaler.suppress_during_rollout=true` (env var set on deploy 6m ago). Recommendation: lift suppression if safe.

harpreet: if autoscaler suppressed, manual scale is the right short-term play. Also check any kernel OOMs on the embedder hosts. I'll ssh into eu-west-embed-02.

maya: taking on log aggregation and customer impact tally. pulling last 30m of traces. Found a correlation: client HTTP/2 connection reuse failing with TLS handshake errors to embedder in eu-west. Suspect upstream proxy config change.

alex: update — manual scale completed, instances coming up, but 5xx still at ~18%. environment shows new proxy version 2.4.1 rolled 7m ago (matches sam's note). Reverting proxy to 2.4.0 on a canary host to test.

sam: i've started rollback on one eu-west proxy canary, logs show fewer TLS handshake errors on canary after revert.

alex: PagerDuty note: claimed by alex. If I need to hand off I'll @maya.

maya: I can take over incident coordination if alex wants to focus on rollback. I'm posting a short customer-impact blurb for comms: "We are investigating elevated errors affecting inference requests in US and EU. Some customers may see increased errors and latency. Mitigation in progress." Please thumbs-up for send.

harpreet: thumbs-up from infra — keep me on DMs for kernel OOMs.

sam: can confirm canary revert reduced 5xx to ~6% on that host after 90s. Rolling revert to remainder of eu-west proxies now.

alex: eu-west proxies rolled back, 5xx dropped to 4% there. us-west still at ~10% — rolling revert there next.

maya: (status) customer impact: approx 12% of requests globally had errors during peak; top affected customers are high-throughput embed users. No data loss; errors are 5xx not 4xx. We're preparing an incident status update for support.

sam: us-west revert complete. global 5xx now down to ~1-2%. tail latency back to baseline.

alex: taking 1-line: "Mitigation: rolled back proxy release 2.4.1 -> 2.4.0; manually scaled inference pool while autoscaler suppression flagged; confirmed error rate returned to baseline." Adding to PagerDuty.

pagerbot: PagerDuty INC1234567 status updated: acknowledged by alex, severity remains P1 until postmortem.

maya: handoff: alex will stay on page for 10m to verify stability, then I'll take incident lead and coordinate the postmortem and customer comms.

alex: agreed. leaving immediate mitigation to team. Will keep an eye for 10m.

harpreet: infra follow-ups I'll own: verify autoscaler suppression flag (why it was enabled during rollout), check embedder host kernel logs, and add health checks to catch TLS handshake regression earlier.

maya: ops follow-ups I'll own: draft support message, collect affected customer list and sample traces, run regression eval on a subset of prompts to ensure model outputs ok after scaled pool changes.

sam: dev follow-ups: add guard to rollout to not flip autoscaler suppression without explicit approver, and add quick rollback playbook.

alex: final note before handoff: no customer-facing outage expected now; follow-up postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 11:00 PT. I'll add summary to incident channel when done. :white_check_mark:

pagerbot: Incident INC1234567 — current status: stabilizing. Next update by maya in ~10m.

maya: taking over as lead. will post next update in this thread.
